name: Remember window size, split ratios and panel tabs between runs
body:
# Persisted layout

Window size, the two split ratios and which asset/outliner tab is open go into the settings file on exit and are
restored on start. Needs the split ratio to be readable from Nyx (penumbra-ui-backend).

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27 for window size, snapping, view options, bookmarks, the bottom panel tab and recent files (~/.config/lantern/world-editor.json, D-035). Split ratios are not saved: the <split> primitive has no onResize yet; follow-up card.
